name: In One Piece
tagline: You never need to raise your voice. Everyone knows you could.
epigraph: In honour of a night when the bar could pour only soft drinks.
glassware: a tall glass, filled with ice
language_row: Wren's resonance: ready (v2; reaffirmed on v3 in r6). Lint 4-grams clean against every pour (Wren r4–r5). Gendered pronouns in y1–y3 refer to Sol Stoumen only, accepted by Wren and Hester.
sources: Fact card `_studio/fact-cards/sol-stoumen-black-cat.md`: *Stoumen v. Reilly*, 37 Cal.2d 713 (1951, SCOCAL, primary); Gary Kamiya, *San Francisco Chronicle*, 14 Nov 2014; US National Park Service, "José Sarria"; Thinkwalks, "The Black Cat Café" (corroboration only); Nick Sibilla, *Reason*, 28 Jun 2015. Drink: Wondrich, *Imbibe!* (pdf 117); *The Oxford Companion to Spirits and Cocktails* (pdf 410, 546, 548, 902–903); *The Flavor Matrix* (pdf 132, 140). Room notes `work/outlaw-caregiver/`.
names_note: In One Piece (Tomás; the room's pick, all three, r5–r6). Nothing Stronger (Wren's first pick) moved to second: a second "Nothing…" name after *Nothing to It*, it repeats the epigraph, and read cold or ordered aloud it says there's nothing stronger in the glass. Also considered: Winter Warmer, Long Twist; set aside: Never Raised, Keep the Room.
open_items: No Flavor Matrix spark: Ginger (pdf 132) and Grape (pdf 140) consulted; candidates set aside as nuts, heat, or sibling-owned (Tomás's Checks). The drink is made interesting by the story, the whole-lemon spiral and VSOP at the one size that's felt.
Not veto-free: ginger ale is tabled as `spice` (Oxford pdf 902–903: unregulated, some brands may contain capsaicin).
Ginger ale sugar and acid values in the spec are unsourced label values (Tomás).
What was poured at the Black Cat that night is on no page beyond "soft drinks and juices"; the drink is never claimed as what he served.
Kept out on purpose: Stoumen's sexuality, the raids, the Holocaust detail, the $38,000 and "no other bar owner helped" (Wikipedia only); whether 1963 was the last night (sources differ).
